label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Kethyl et Mesk Lurrel
english: VI.3 · The Knowing of the Green Wood

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et bremm vranast, amm re orr et sulter dem neld.
english: *The sixth autumn, when the boat went out.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Seren Pa Luth, sa re heth et greller. Vess sy re yala Halyna lom lo et tolm, garl eth garl lo sest en narl; eth sell re hether o hosen ull, tevar hy wrodhol.
english: *Laid by Seren Two-Inks, that held the lamp. Tonight {{Halyna}} stood with me at the stone, a hand each beside mine, and a long while we held it so ere any of us spake.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et orl ull re firr et reskow strom nothast ul vodh re omm o: domm o veskdhrenn, eth treskat lunnat, brunnel scethvesk susk hy dhavowlest. Ew Neivaere o, ul nyrulath Sirrvell. Nath re orrant et hesperdeth virr, hy vodh re ludalant o, sennet sost.
english: All that day lay the tenth Throne where it fell, black of grain and split open, a hill of timber higher than a harbour-house. It was {LAST_THRONE_AT_HAVEN}. The soldiers would not go nigh it, for they feared it even dead.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hethe Halyna rost molt hy et heth. Ew mesk sennet gor hos.
english: Nine hearts had {{Halyna}} known since the spring. Each was dead wood.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem hedh re rarr et Crenn sost dem vimm, demo, eth re ston o sell virr, eth o wiskhovv dem susk. Hy ull re vesk o dem Halyna.
english: Toward evening came the Captain down to it himself, and stood long beside it with his hood up. Then he looked to {{Halyna}}.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh re vellora sona, eth en ul sona sestow lo et greller. Ul susk re omm et nynth, semm eth semm. Ul meskdhrenn hemm sost re firr et molt, myst eth duss eth sol.
english: At dusk they went in, and I behind them with the lamp. Overhead the water dripped. In the oldest of the grain lay the heart, grey and hard and still.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo sest et molt, ul dresk et meskvolt, re firr saedel sa new sell hy yarl.
english: Beside it, in a crack of the heartwood, lay a sliver no longer than a hand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew lurrel o.
english: It was green.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymmym et greller dem vimm, demo, hy vodh nath re oskom et baegyth.
english: I brought the lamp down to it, for I trusted not the light.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vran grem re raevular et kaelireth dem haralath, eth et moltath dem vollath, eth et myst dem wemmeth. Nath re raevul hos hyor galat sa hoss. Veth re hoss sy ul nomm volt sennet, hosen hossant gendeleth ul dresk hald.
english: Six winters had we searched the wrecks for orders, and the hearts for names, and the grey for sails. Not one of us had looked for a thing that lived. Yet this had lived in the dark of a dead heart, as seedlings live in the crack of a wall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et grem hosast, re yal hosel garl um vesk loskat lonta. Veth re selle garl eth garl, eth re femme o ul hos clemel.
english: One hand only had {{Halyna}} needed on any wood since the first winter. All the same they put out a hand each, and touched it in the same moment.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re omm semm hy et mesketh ul et vem, eth re vedh o.
english: A drop fell from the timbers into the flame, and hissed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hyl pa lern Halyna hosen hos.
english: Their two faces changed as one.

label: Romanisation
rom: New haral o, ell grestet. Re wrodh Rhyna, hosen amm re hadh hos et brod ul ey brodow, eth re orr dem neld.
english: Not an order was it, nor a wound. Rhyna spake, as though one had put the word into her mouth and gone away.

label: Romanisation
rom: Varn.
english: "Home."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vysk Halvard: El venn o. Veth nath re hebb et mesk lurrel et brod hosel, eth nath re hess o ul vodh hesser. Re vyske sona o olen, ul hos hoss:
english: Halvard said that she was right. But the green wood gave not the word alone, and it stopped not where we stop. They said it together, in one breath:

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Tumar ol varn eth.
english: *We remember our home too.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re semm Rhyna, eth nath re semm Halvard, hy vodh re yal ey ul semmyl dem bana. Re hethym et greller dem dunnol Hyna.
english: Rhyna wept, and Halvard did not, for she was weeping for them both. I held the lamp till Rhyna had done.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re hebbe sona lom et galat ullen, esket ul et tessyl hosen doss fymmet esket ul nanth: et voll sa hebb lunt et mesk lont sost. Naelear, lunt et hoss. Sull fedh re vyskym o, tevar hy rytyl, eth re ston o. El brod et orrow hosel, Mystaeri.
english: Then gave they me the other thing, folded in the answer as a seed is folded in a fruit: the name the wood's own people give themselves. *Naelear*, those of the breath. Three times I said it over ere I wrote it, and it held. *Mystaeri* is but the word of the shore.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy rarrol et dusstyvil, nath re dhev hos flenn um et gannath. Re dhovvant dem et helv hosen re yal o.
english: Since the iron came, not a leaf had the pillars put up. They had waited for the sky to come again.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull, ew fymmet o.
english: So it was seed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymm Rhyna o dem susk dem Gethow, um feth, eth garl Halvard ul vimm ey sestyarl. Dem et parow re hask nemm sugornan hy et kethow rerddhalden, ey sa re heth et greller bridlernen, eth re vess ey: Ul vodh es morr o?
english: Up to the Keep Rhyna bare it on moss, with Halvard's hand under her elbow. Into the ward ran a fisher-girl of the east keep, she that kept the north lamp, and asked whither it would go.

label: Romanisation
rom: Varn.
english: "Home."

label: Romanisation
rom: Eth doss maver umona weskyl sulter demo.
english: "And we two must find it a boat."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss sulter stonwrytel ul ryteth surr et Stonwrytan, nahos. Gor fedh ew et wadh galat sa re yaldar hald ul o lern, eth new orrol o fedh.
english: In all the annals of the guild there is no Stonewright's boat. The sea was ever a thing we walled against, and never a road.

label: Romanisation
rom: Veth re lymm pynullan et cummath et duvereth dem susk et brunn, hosen tolmardath et bresketh. Ul et ryst re orr et pynullan dem vimm, dem dhysal. Ew hemm sost hyont Tarnard, gedh Dharnel. Re hadh o sost et breller.
english: But up the mountain had the boatwrights of the havens carried their adzes, as the masons their chisels. On the morrow they came down to the shingle. The eldest of them was Tarnard, Tarnel's father. The keel he laid himself.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et nelter re lymm Harl Orrow sa Vorr et crynir hosast um o sest. Gor hrynir et gorrol, re vysk o: Vorra o. Re hadh o et crynir sy lo visketh Dharnard, eth re vysk o nayalat. Re hadh Tarnard garlremull ryss umo.
english: Out of the vault Harl of the burning shore bare the first plank on his shoulder. *Burn it*, he had said of every plank of the war. This one he set down at Tarnard's feet, and said naught. Tarnard laid his palm flat on it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Mesk sa re sesk et wadh, mesk sa sesk et orrol dem varn.
english: "Wood that knew the sea knoweth the way home."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy hrynireth et nelter re yaldant o. Re vysk gor hos lor hos fedh; eth amm sy es dessent demor.
english: Of the vault's planks they built it. Every one had spoken to us once, and now they would speak for us.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem lernyann re rik Tarnard pana sa re hadhom, cless treskat lo hless treskat: et hos sa re vysk Orrow, eth et hos velv. Re roskura Orvenna so hosen doss tolm roskurat. Re heth Penna et roskur dasken, eth re runn Ormund o, hos fedh.
english: For the stem Tarnard took the two I had laid raw edge to raw edge: the one that said *shore*, and the silent one. {{Orvenna}} keyed them as stone is keyed. Penna held the last key, and Ormund struck it, once.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hemm et meskdhrenn cresket, eth re heth o.
english: The broken grain met, and held.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh ull re ryte Halyna et rellor um et brellir: re hadh hos et bresk, eth re runn ullen. Tevar hy ull, nath re orr rellor hyor ul et mesk fedh. Re hethym et greller, eth re vorr o dem vimm, ryssyth nind.
english: That evening {{Halyna}} cut their mark across the join, the one setting the chisel and the other striking. Never ere then had a mark of ours gone into wood. I held the lamp, and it burned down a finger's width.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth et mesk o.
english: The wood took it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh Rhyna pa yarlremull um et rytet, eth Halvard pa yarl umont.
english: Rhyna laid her palms on the cut, and Halvard his hands over hers.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lusk Tarnard lom byskyl et lern. Re yaldom bysket Dharnel umo, sa re ammad o lom um et orrol sell, hos bysket ul hos bost lusul. Sell re vesk Tarnard umo. Hy ull re vysk o, velv, myskyl o dhev:
english: The lashing of the bow Tarnard left for me. I tied it with Tarnel's knot, that he taught me on the Road, a knot to a mile. Long looked Tarnard at it. Then he said his son's saying, low:

label: Romanisation
rom: Piskur, el bysketeth hosel o, garl ul narl.
english: "A net is only knots holding hands."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hos orl re haemer o ul neld et pell, ul fodh duss, eth nath re rik o nynth. Ew lyss o, eth ew tunn o.
english: A day it rode off the point in a hard swell, and took no water. It was small, and it was sound.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo hyll hedhen re orr et odh tunn dem vimm, et hemmeth ul ferryl um et tevan. Re hadha Halyna et saedel lurrel lo lern et sulter, um et feth, lo et lernyann roskurat. Lo sest et saedel re hadha sona Stonwryt, saed styvil eth saed tolm domm: osk, hoskat ul dolm. Ew ull ol hebbet vallat sost. Hy ull re hadha sona et pa wresk lo sest et Stonwryt, eth lo lern et sulter re rike et pa wresk et hedh.
english: At the evening tide came the whole hearth down, the old leaning on the young. {{Halyna}} laid the green sliver in the bow on its moss, against the keyed stem. Beside it they set a Stonwryt coin, part gold and part black stone: trust, sealed in stone. It was our dearest gift. Then they laid their two chisels by it, and in the bow the chisels took the last of the light.

label: Romanisation
rom: Luska sona ul morrol lo,
english: "Let them go with it,"

label: Romanisation
rom: hy vodh re ryten olna rellor dasken.
english: "for we two have cut our last mark."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re wrodh hos um et dhysal. Re lumma Halyna um et dhysal thenth, ul lern et sulter, eth ul sona sestow re lumm et odh tunn. Re hadhant et hesperdeth et hagesseth dem vimm. Re lumm Kael Nydherd, sa nath resk amm cadh trenn, lo et ullen. Lo rask et trenn, eth o wiskhovv dem susk, re lumm et Crenn.
english: No one on the shingle spake. {{Halyna}} kneeled on the wet stones before the bow, and behind them the whole hearth kneeled. The soldiers laid down their pikes. Kael the Counter, that will not sit to tell a tale, kneeled with the rest. Last in the line, with his hood up, kneeled the Captain.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss o ul reskyl lo ull amm sy, lo rask et prenth. El domm tul thenthyth et dhysal um o yerdeth.
english: There he sitteth now, at the end of the bench. The wet of the shingle is dark yet on his knees.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et lern re vyske Halyna:
english: From the front {{Halyna}} said:

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem ull doss orrol lo hos lunt hosel: et hebbet, eth et lummol.
english: "So far can one people go alone: the gift, and the kneeling."

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss maver um et ullen: et lunt ullen.
english: "The rest needeth the other."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr fodh dem susk et dhysal, eth re ridh o et breller. Hy ull re dhald Harl, eth re rik o et lern ul pa sestyarl, eth re orr o lo dem vimm, ul et hyll. Re hastant tevath sugornan o dem neld. Hosast, dem ey molt ul et wadh brid, ew et nemm sa re vess ul vodh es morr o.
english: A wave came up the shingle and wet the keel. Then rose Harl, and took the bow in his two arms, and walked it down into the tide. The fisher-children pushed it off. Foremost, to her waist in the cold sea, was the girl that had asked whither it would go.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul neld, lo hyll sa orr hyo, re hyl et sulter. Re orr o ul lern et helvhoss, eth ul lern et kess, eth ul et myst.
english: Well out on the ebb, the boat turned. Into the wind it went, and against the current, and into the grey.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et dhysal re yalant et higileth hemm, eth Merrik hosast. Vran grem re hylent so lerneth hy et wadh, amm re vorr sceth.
english: Along the shingle stood the old ship-masters, and Merrick first. Six winters had they turned their faces from the sea when a hull burned.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re veskent dem neld.
english: They did not look away.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · Seren’s closing line
rom: Eth re dhess nahos.
english: *And no one answered.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re orr sull garl hy et tolm, re yal et odh velv sell. Re vorr et odhvorr dem vimm, eth nath re dhald hos dem gadhol mesk umo. Re dhovvar, kaeverym, ryssyth hos carm hemm. Doss Ebba Sedhnell ul vimm et stelleth rerddhalden.
english: When we three took our hands from the stone, the hearth was silent a long while. The fire burned down, and none rose to lay wood on it. We waited, I think, the width of one old voice. Ebba of Fenholm is under the east cairns.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re wrodh tev, virr ul lern, nawont. Ew et nemm sa re orr hosast ul et wadh. Ew ey scaelur hemm Ebba hemm.
english: Then a child near the front spake, not loudly. It was the girl that went first into the sea. Old Ebba was her great-grandmother.

label: Romanisation
rom: Tumar.
english: "We remember."

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Hy ull, ul et fedh hosast, re vell et odh hosen et mesk. Pa Varn vollar o:
english: *Then for the first time the hearth sang in the wood's way. We call it* The Two Homes:

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Re yal ol varn dannat hy hal;
english:
*Our home was hewn from the mountain's bone;*
*we forgot it, and found it, and held it in blood.*
*Their home was breathed from the hearts of the trees, and the axes came, and the breath grew thin, and they have not found it, and they cannot hold it.*
*Stone keeps the vow, and the grain keeps the truth.*
*We remember our home. They remember theirs too.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: re nadhumar o, eth re wesker o, eth re hether o ul lorr.
english:
*Our home was hewn from the mountain's bone;*
*we forgot it, and found it, and held it in blood.*
*Their home was breathed from the hearts of the trees, and the axes came, and the breath grew thin, and they have not found it, and they cannot hold it.*
*Stone keeps the vow, and the grain keeps the truth.*
*We remember our home. They remember theirs too.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Re yal so varn hossat hy voltath et mesketh, eth re rarrant et dannwresketh, eth re hyl et hoss ul mynt, eth nath re weskent o, eth nath noss o hethyl lont.
english:
*Our home was hewn from the mountain's bone;*
*we forgot it, and found it, and held it in blood.*
*Their home was breathed from the hearts of the trees, and the axes came, and the breath grew thin, and they have not found it, and they cannot hold it.*
*Stone keeps the vow, and the grain keeps the truth.*
*We remember our home. They remember theirs too.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Keth tolm et ryt, eth keth meskdhrenn et vennoth.
english:
*Our home was hewn from the mountain's bone;*
*we forgot it, and found it, and held it in blood.*
*Their home was breathed from the hearts of the trees, and the axes came, and the breath grew thin, and they have not found it, and they cannot hold it.*
*Stone keeps the vow, and the grain keeps the truth.*
*We remember our home. They remember theirs too.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Tumar ol varn. Tumant so varn eth.
english:
*Our home was hewn from the mountain's bone;*
*we forgot it, and found it, and held it in blood.*
*Their home was breathed from the hearts of the trees, and the axes came, and the breath grew thin, and they have not found it, and they cannot hold it.*
*Stone keeps the vow, and the grain keeps the truth.*
*We remember our home. They remember theirs too.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Tolm hy et Myst
english: The Stone out of the Grey

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et surr gemmest ul sestow et Mymmyleth.
english: *The fourth year after the homecomings.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Cadhat um et flenn sa ross ul lern et covv treskat sa re hadh Kael. Hy et vess hosast re yal et flenn ull pondul. Hy ull re rytym meskdhrenn umo, eth hos trenn ul en narl: Nawrodhat. Nath noss tul kethyl et gunn sy lo Halyna. Ul et dask, nath re losk hos kethyl Halyna o.
english: *Set down on the leaf that faceth Kael's torn cloak. From the first night that leaf stood empty. Later I drew the grain on it, and one line in mine hand:* Untold. {{Halyna}} cannot yet hold this deep. *In the end no knowing of {{Halyna}}'s filled it.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: Rytym sy hosel, ul hos luth, hy vodh nath noss hos amm sy sa heth et mesk demom. Stonant broc um en nenth et pa luth.
english: I write this alone, in one ink, for there is none now to know the wood for me. Dry on my table stand their two inks.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dossa Halyna sennet.
english: {{Halyna}} are gone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et grem dhomast re senne sona ul hos vess, hosen senn et Lodhan: Rhyna hosast, ul naedh, eth Halvard tevar hy sennyl et greller, hy vodh re sesk o. Firre ul vimm hosk clenn et ganna ulvenn, ul hos ledal, lo hos tolm, eth hos voll umo. Firrent umonta, lern dem vimm, sona rellor, sona ryt eth et Hosk, ul vodh es vesk nahos pawast so, somm ston et hald.
english: In the seventh winter they went in one night, as the Bonded go: Rhyna first, in her sleep, and Halvard ere the lamp was out, for he knew. They lie under the new capstone of the inner gate, in one grave, with one stone, and one name on it. Face down above them are their mark, their vow and the Title, where no eye will see them again till the wall fall.

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Lo et ledal re velle Orvenna, Ormund dem et hessel eth Penna et ullen:
english: *At the grave sang {{Orvenna}}, Ormund to the comma and Penna the rest:*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Tolm um dholm, eth keth et tolm vennoth;
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: garl um yarl, eth keth et garl venn;
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: pa lo yanna, amm cemment wemmeth myst,
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: pa lo yanna, eth ston et ganna tunn.
english:
*Stone upon stone, and the stone keeps faith;*
*hand over hand, and the hand holds true;*
*two at the gate when the grey sails gather,*
*two at the gate, and the gate stands through.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hossa Idrenna, sa re yala hemm amm re yala Halyna tevel, pana. Ul surr et mymmyleth, tevar hy orrol et pa wresk ul myst, re ryte Halyna voll Halvard ul vimm vollath o yedheth, ul hosk et bystir rerdsennen. Ul vimm ull el dasorat et tolm, eth nath noss hos hy o dhrenn sa es ryt o.
english: {{Idrenna}}, that were old when {{Halyna}} were young, have outlived them both. In the year of the homecomings, ere their chisels went into the grey, {{Halyna}} cut Halvard's name under his fathers' in the western stair. Beneath it the stone is smooth, and none of his line is left to cut it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vess ull re dhresk et Crenn ryssyth yarl hy saed et covv sa hovv o, eth re wysk o o um hagess, ul susk et ganna. Ew ull saedel dasken et saed. Ul et grem ull re orr o, ul hosel covv myst.
english: That night the Captain cut a hand's breadth from his half of the cloak, and bound it on a pike over the gate. It was the last of his half. Into that winter went he in a plain grey cloak.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re orrom lo Halyna. Re wrodha sona lom hos fedh: Doss orrol loth, hosel, ul vodh nath noss orrol lona; eth doss seryl et flennath sy loth. Amm sy hyrrilym Ryt Dhunnoth. Nath lymm Mardh et hos, veth amm lusk galdat lo et ullen.
english: I went not with {{Halyna}}. Alone, they told me once, I could go where they could not, and carry this Book on. Now I understand the Covenant. God taketh not the one without leaving the other a work to do.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss sy lom.
english: This is mine.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess sa re hadhom en drenn hosast, re yal ludal wrodhol umom, eth re hadha Halyna en narlath pana um et tolm.
english: The night I laid my first tale, I was afraid to speak, and {{Halyna}} laid my two hands on the stone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm.
english: "Hold the stone."

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth o, eth es geth tho.
english: "Hold it, and it will hold thee."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss ullen amm sy sa dhunn o; myskym pa saed, hosel.
english: There is none now to finish it, and I say both halves alone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et heth dhomast, um ryst helvnynth bynt, re vellor sulter lyss myst hy et myst. Re dhav o sost dem susk et dhysal, eth nath re yal hos ulo.
english: In the seventh spring, on a morning of thin rain, out of the grey came a small grey boat. It ran itself up the shingle, and no one was in it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yalant et higileth hemm lo wisk et dhysal, eth nath re rarrant mest virr. Re orrant et tevath dem vimm ul hos fedh. Re hadh et hosast pa yarl ryss um et lern. Re dhess tev et mesk lurrel, amm nath re yal tessyl lor.
english: The old ship-masters stood at the head of the shingle, and came no further. The children went down in a crowd. The first laid both her hands flat on the bow. A child had answered the green wood, when none of us could.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew et tev sost o.
english: It was the same child.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re orr Merrik dem vimm, niss, sa re hyl o lern hy sceth eth sceth sa re vorr.
english: Then down came Merrick, slowly, that had turned his face from every hull that burned.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh Merrik garl um sest et sulter.
english: Merrick laid his hand on its gunwale.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo rask re orrom dem vimm, eth re dhreskent et tevath ul en lern, hosen tresk et wadh ul lern wreller. Lo lernyann re seskym et sulter: et molt hosast roskurat, eth rellor Halyna um et brellir.
english: Last went I down, and the children parted before me, as water before a keel. By its stem I knew the boat: the first heart keyed, and {{Halyna}}'s mark across the join.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re orr o dem varn, eth re rarr o dem varn. Lo lern et sulter, ul vodh re hadha Halyna et saedel lurrel eth et pa wresk, re firr tolm.
english: It had gone home, and it had come home. In its bow, where {{Halyna}} laid the green sliver and their chisels, lay a stone.

label: Romanisation
rom: New tolm o. Ell ew tolm o sa re yal mesk, hosen hebbet et Arra. Voll et Treskan o: Tolm Myst; eth mysk: Tum o gor yalat.
english: It was not stone. Or it was stone that had been wood, like the Guest's gift. Myststone the Rivenmen call it, and say it remembereth all.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss brodlymmyl lo dholm. Veth new hosel tolm o fedh. Re ryt garl o sa re rystull et bresk desir, eth gell: tevel hosen nydhent, kaeverym, eth fedhet hosen nydher.
english: Stone does not translate. But this was never only stone. The hand that cut it learned the chisel late, and learned it well: young by their reckoning, I think, and seasoned by ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hess et helvnynth. Re firr et wadh, myst hosen halflenn, eth re orr et hyll dem sestow, lo hunnat sell.
english: The rain had stopped. Grey as slate lay the sea, and the tide drew back with a long sound.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re seskym et dest.
english: I knew the bite.

label: Romanisation
rom: Pa fedh re hethym et greller dem et bresk ull: ul vimm et hosk clenn, eth um et lernyann sy.
english: Twice had I held the lamp for that chisel, under the new capstone and across this stem.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal o rytet ul ol dolmath sost. Nath re hadhom en narlremullath umo. Re yal o rytet dem hos sa vesk hosel. Re veskym o ul garm dem et tevath.
english: It was cut in our own letters. I laid not my palms on it. It was cut so that one could read it alone. I read it out to the children.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Ul et dumol ol varn, ol theldeth…
english: *In the memory of our home, our families...*

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo ull re hresk et ryt, eth el gand tul et stinel dasken. Nath re vesk o ol govv fedh, hy vodh nath re farr o fedh. Re rystull o ol dolmath. Vollom o: Ryterd Dasken, hy vodh kaeverym: amm re ryt o sy, nath re yal ullen.
english: There the cutting broke off, and its last stroke is sharp yet. Our cloak he never saw, for he never sailed. Our letters he learned. The Last Carver I call him, for I think that when he cut this there was no other.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss hos brod ulo sa nath re yal lo ol Hosk fedh: et, cadhat ul lern dhumol. Re veskym o hosen re yal o rytet, eth nath re dhyvull tev. Re haeverym: Ho hess o lo ull, hy vodh re hess o yarl?
english: One word is in it that our Title never had: *the*, set before *memory*. I read it as it was cut, and no child laughed. I have wondered whether it stoppeth there because his hand stopped.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr o hosel, eth nayess el podul ull. Nath re nethiler darrol arra tul.
english: No one came with it, and perhaps that is wise. We have not yet earned a guest.

label: Romanisation
rom: Tevar hy rask et heth ull re orr et hulter hy yorn et gannalest, eth nath re vesk hos amm re rik et Crenn o. Ul vodh re ferr o, doss stinel midh ul et tuss dhom grem. Amm bethirys et trenn, orra, eth veska um et tuss. Doss et galdat tunn. Seskym et bystir sa hess.
english: Ere that spring was out the staff was gone from the gatehouse, and no one saw the Captain take it. Where it leaned there is a clean stroke in the dust of seven winters. If you doubt the tale, go and look at the dust. The work is done. I know *the stair that goes no more*.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re orrom dem vimm dem veskyl.
english: I have not gone down to look.

label: Romanisation
rom: Kethym et flennath sy ul vestul rytow, ul molt et tolmath nawrodh, lo sest hebbet et Arra eth et Tolm sy. El vadullen lomm, eth doss o nethilet dem devath. Dhenth et Covv Treskat tul ul susk et hos ledal. Nath dunn et wadh tul.
english: In the archive chest I keep this Book, among the mute stones, by the Guest's gift and this Stone. Grief is an inheritance, and it is paid out to the children. Over the one grave the torn cloak flieth yet. The sea hath not finished.

label: Romanisation
rom: Galat sa es luskar dem sestow, nath seskym o. Nath seskym galat veth sy: doss maver umor luskol et tessyl, ul lummol.
english: What we will send back, I know not. I know only that it must be sent kneeling.

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor vess doss et ganna ulvenn lunnat, hosen es wesk arra o; eth um et hald bridlernen keth tev greller.
english: Every night is the inner gate left open, as a guest would find it, and on the north wall a child keepeth a light.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the Captain’s answer
rom: Eth re hadh et Crenn et biskhovv dem sestow.
english: *And the Captain put his hood back.*
